dt03 сортировка: числа, текст посимвольно, порядок словаря, равные значения
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@dt03") { end_thread() }
    cancel_event()
    down = sort_any_list([9, 100, 10], sort_mode: descending)
    up = sort_any_list([9, 100, 10])
    words = sort_any_list(["9", "100", "10"], sort_mode: ascending)
    send_message("dt03 вниз=${join_text(down, ",")} вверх=${join_text(up, ",")} текст=${join_text(words, ",")}")
    m = {"z": 1, "a": 2, "m": 3}
    by_key = sort_any_map(m, sort_order: ascending, sort_type: keys)
    by_value = sort_any_map(m, sort_order: descending, sort_type: values)
    send_message("dt03 порядок=${join_text(get_map_keys(m), ",")} ключи=${join_text(get_map_keys(by_key), ",")} значения=${join_text(get_map_keys(by_value), ",")}")
    same = sort_any_map({"b": 1, "a": 1, "c": 1}, sort_order: descending, sort_type: values)
    send_message("dt03 равные=${join_text(get_map_keys(same), ",")}")
}

name: dt06 числа: сокращение, склонение, полоска, разряды, вывод целых и дробей
code:
const DT06_MINUTES = ["минут", "минута", "минуты", "минуты", "минуты", "минут", "минут", "минут", "минут", "минут"]

func dt06_short(n: number) {
    if n >= 1000000 { return "${round(n / 1000000, 1)}M" }
    if n >= 1000 { return "${round(n / 1000, 1)}K" }
    return "${n}"
}

func dt06_plural(n: number, forms: list) {
    if n % 100 in 11..14 { return forms[0] }
    return forms[n % 10]
}

func dt06_bar(done: number, total: number) {
    line full = floor(done * 10 / total)
    return "${repeat_text("#", full)}${repeat_text("-", 10 - full)}"
}

when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@dt06") { end_thread() }
    cancel_event()
    a = dt06_short(999)
    b = dt06_short(1500)
    c = dt06_short(2500000)
    send_message("dt06 кратко ${a} ${b} ${c}")
    p1 = dt06_plural(1, DT06_MINUTES)
    p2 = dt06_plural(3, DT06_MINUTES)
    p5 = dt06_plural(5, DT06_MINUTES)
    p11 = dt06_plural(11, DT06_MINUTES)
    p21 = dt06_plural(21, DT06_MINUTES)
    send_message("dt06 слова ${p1} ${p2} ${p5} ${p11} ${p21}")
    n = 1234567
    spaced = regex_replace_text("${n}", "(?<=[0-9])(?=([0-9]{3})+$)", " ")
    send_message("dt06 разряды ${spaced}")
    r = round(3.14159, 2)
    f = round(2.9, 0, round_type: floor)
    send_message("dt06 округление ${r} ${f}")
    w = 6
    h = 10 / 4
    send_message("dt06 вывод целое=${w} формула=${w / 2} дробь=${h} треть=${1 / w}")
    t = value.timestamp
    send_message("dt06 метка=${t}")
    b0 = dt06_bar(0, 10)
    b3 = dt06_bar(3, 10)
    b10 = dt06_bar(10, 10)
    send_message("dt06 полоски ${b0} ${b3} ${b10}")
}
